description: Street Pavement Surface Condition Data is a dataset listed in City of Winnipeg open data portal (data.winnipeg.ca), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Winnipeg. This information includes street pavement surface condition data from the 2023 rating season. The City collects data on its surfaced streets such as concrete, asphalt over concrete or composite, and asphalt only. A general condition is determined for every segment which can be new, good, fair or poor. Coverage: Winnipeg. The portal files it under the category Transportation Planning & Traffic Management. The table has 7 columns. The portal shows 2026-09-01 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-winnipeg-ca-portal.
